name: @w6w-apps/cleverreach
description: Manage CleverReach receivers, groups, attributes, tags, mailings, reports and the blacklist.

w6w.longDescription:
CleverReach is a European email-marketing platform. This app lets a workflow keep its subscriber data in step with the rest of the business: add, update, upsert, activate, deactivate and delete receivers; manage the groups (receiver lists) they belong to; create attributes; tag receivers; and read the blacklist and add to it.

It also reads what happened after a send: list mailings and fetch one, and list and fetch the reports for them, so a workflow can react to a campaign that finished or stop sending to an address that bounced.

It connects with a REST API access token pasted from Account > Extras > REST API, or with an OAuth app's client id and secret, which the app exchanges for a token and renews itself. The vendor's forms endpoints are deprecated and are not covered.
